newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banamex grants new discounts to mortgage clients.
newsitem.headline: Banamex grants new discounts to mortgage clients.

text.p: Mexican bank Banamex, a unit of Grupo Financiero Banamex-Accival (Banacci), said on Tuesday it will offer its mortgage clients discounts of up to 25 percent in their monthly payments if they have 12 consecutive on-time payments.
Banamex's discount is in addition to a government-sponsored 25 percent discount.
"The program will begin for clients as of June 23 and will be up to 50 percent (for the year)," a bank spokeswoman who declined to be named told Reuters.
Clients with less than 12 on-time payments can receive up to a 20 percent discount, according to Banamex.
Banamex will also add an additional 10 percent to the 10 percent government discount for clients who make early mortgage payments.
The company would not comment on how the plan would affect Banacci's earnings.
The bank holds about 30 percent of Mexican middle and upper-class residential mortgages.
Mushrooming mortgage debt following the 1995 peso crisis has plagued the Mexican banking system and spurred both the banks and the governments to provide incentives to debtors.
